store.name: profile
store.note: Kept apart from the three save slots and the autosave. A save never holds these keys and loading a save never changes them (DESIGN.md section 12, 'The loop').

keys.name: run.number
keys.write_note: Plus one when an ending resolves, so the next new game is the next turn of the cycle.

keys.name: shelf.generations
keys.write_note: Appends the entries the ending's row in 'shelf_writes' names. The next run's shelf, guestbook and four Act 1 incidents are built from the entries whose run is the previous run; older entries are the circle of torn fabric skins.

keys.name: shelf.previous_ending
keys.write_note: Set to the id of the ending that resolved.

keys.name: book.carried
keys.write_note: Appends one entry for each book.spread_N true this run that is not already carried. Those spreads start the next run already in order.

derived.name: run.hunt_group
derived.note: Not stored in the profile: derived from run.number at every new game. Odd runs bring Group B, even runs Group C.

shelf_writes.note: Each herded guest, with their stuffed form.
